definitions.explanation: Swimming as a competitive sport, including races in various strokes and distances. Distinct from recreational swimming or water polo.

examples.japanese: {競泳|きょうえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I competed in a swimming meet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{競泳|きょうえい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{金|きん}メダル→金メダル：20781_kinmedaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: She won a gold medal in competitive swimming.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{競泳|きょうえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: I've been doing competitive swimming since elementary school and now I'm aiming for the Olympics.

notes:
FORMS:
{競|きょう} (to compete) + {泳|えい} (swimming).

USAGE:
Used specifically for competitive swimming as a sport. For swimming in general (recreational), use ⟦{水泳|すいえい}→水泳：01623_suiei⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {競泳|きょうえい}⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧ (competitive swimmer)
- {競泳|きょうえい}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦{水着|みずぎ}→水着：00286_mizugi⟧ (racing swimsuit)
- {競泳|きょうえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ (swimming meet/competition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水泳|すいえい}→水泳：01623_suiei⟧: swimming in general (including recreational)
- {競泳|きょうえい}: competitive swimming specifically
